newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks up to 55,000 T edible oils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks up to 55,000 T edible oils.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Monday it wanted to buy between 34,000 and 55,000 tonnes of edible oils for delivery in the first half of November or the first half of December.
Bids will be opened at noon local time (1000 GMT) on October 9 and must be valid for 48 hours.
The oils are in five lots:
-- 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of raw sunflower oil, raw semi- refined cottonseed oil or raw American cottonseed oil of 162 degrees, delivery first half of November.
-- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of raw degummed soy oil, delivery first half of November.
-- 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of raw sunflower oil, raw semi- refined cottonseed oil or raw American cottonseed oil of 162 degrees, delivery first half of December.
-- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of raw degummed soy oil, delivery first half of December.

-- 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes of palm kernel oil or raw coconut oil, buyer's option, delivery in the first half of December. The palm kernel oil must be of Malaysian or Indonesian origin but the coconut oil can be any origin.
